Customer Success Manager, Mid-Market (fictional demo role) - Tavor Cloud, Tel Aviv

About the role
Tavor Cloud is hiring a Customer Success Manager to own a book of mid-market accounts. You will make sure customers get value from the product, renew, and grow with us.

What you will do
- Own renewals and expansion for a portfolio of about 60 mid-market accounts.
- Reduce churn by tracking account health and acting early on risk.
- Run quarterly business reviews with customer executives and show the results they achieved.
- Work with Sales and Product to turn customer feedback into action.
- Keep account data up to date in Gainsight and Salesforce.

Requirements
- 3+ years as a Customer Success Manager in B2B SaaS.
- A track record of renewals and retention, with measurable results.
- Experience running executive business reviews.
- Hands-on experience with Gainsight or a similar customer success platform.
- Clear written and spoken communication.

Nice to have
- Experience with expansion or upsell targets.
- Hebrew and English.
